description: Na₂Sn₂Si₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.97 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.23 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.20 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-34°. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Sn and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Sn, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₂SiSn trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Sn, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₂SiSn trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Sn, and one Si atom.
